confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on two searches that returned aggregated Numbeo-style figures from Expatica (June 2026) and similar sites. Those figures were in EUR, and I converted them at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR, which is an assumption. Cocktail and wine-glass prices were not found directly. I set them from the local beer price and typical Italian bar pricing. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge and not from live listings. They allow for July peak demand, since La Spezia is a base for Cinque Terre. They are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Ligurian and northern Italian coastal cities. La Spezia is cheaper than Cinque Terre villages and Genoa-level tourist areas, and its prices are close to the Italian average.
